aiExplanation.summary: This file shares the active Notes space and validated AI response language with the standalone Agent Notes CLI.
aiExplanation.detail:
- ActiveNotesSelectionRepository: Persists one local runtime snapshot per workspace outside the project.
- save: Atomically records the Notes location and response language.
- load: Validates snapshots and defaults legacy or unsupported language values to English.
- getPath: Derives a stable state filename from the normalized workspace root.
aiNotes: Unique temporary filenames keep concurrent saves from renaming the same temporary path.
